factors.name: operatingDemand
factors.basis: Intel's Q2 2026 filing reported Mobileye segment revenue of $507 million, flat year over year, while YTD Mobileye revenue was $1.1 billion, up $120 million year over year primarily from higher EyeQ demand.

risks: Flat Q2 segment revenue tempers the stronger YTD demand signal.
unknowns: Segment reporting from Intel is corroborative but does not replace Mobileye standalone underwriting.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution

factors.name: guidanceExecution
factors.basis: Mobileye's Q2 2026 SEC-furnished results reported $508 million revenue and raised the midpoint of full-year revenue guidance, narrowing the range to $1.970-$2.020 billion.

risks: Part of the operating-income guidance improvement was tied to an Israeli R&D incentive grant rather than purely underlying operating leverage.
contradictions: Q2 revenue was approximately flat year over year even as full-year revenue guidance improved.
unknowns: Second-half mix and conversion required to reach the updated full-year range remain forward-looking.

sources.origin: SEC EDGAR / Mobileye furnished Q2 2026 results
facts: Full-year 2026 revenue guidance was narrowed to $1.970-$2.020 billion with midpoint raised by $20 million.
Adjusted operating-income guidance improvement was partly related to an Israeli R&D incentive grant.
Mobileye segment revenue was $507 million in Q2 2026, flat versus Q2 2025.
YTD 2026 Mobileye revenue was $1.1 billion, up $120 million year over year primarily from higher EyeQ demand.

result: Materially different SEC-addressed operating and guidance evidence added for Alpha reuse; numeric scoring remains Alpha-owned.
